name: Father Lou Molloy (Marist) Woodlawn Scholarship (SCU)
summary: $5,000 for a student starting an undergraduate degree at SCU, with preference for St John's College Woodlawn graduates.
who: Starting an undergraduate degree at SCU.
Australian citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
Preference for graduates of St John's College Woodlawn, Lismore.
how: Apply through SCU's applying for a scholarship page with a 100 to 200 word statement.

source.label: Southern Cross University: Father Lou Molloy (Marist) Woodlawn Scholarship

evidence.quote: Student must be commencing an undergraduate degree at Southern Cross University.
